description: Provides financial assistance to rural BPL families for the construction of pucca houses with basic amenities.
Upgrades, rehabilitates, and widens major highway corridors across India for seamless inter-state connectivity.
Provides direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families.
Improves nutritional outcomes for children, pregnant women, and lactating mothers using tech-driven monitoring.
Aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections to all rural households.
Provides cooked nutritional meals to school children in government and government-aided schools.
Offers health insurance coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
